content.comment_body: I have a [company_name] [product_name] Starter Kit with an HMI display. However, there are no instructions provided on how the [product_name] can communicate or be linked via software with the HMI display.

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. To program the HMI, you need to install the required software. Inside the software, you have to configure a connection between the [product_name] and the HMI, both in the main programming software and in the associated configuration tool. If you need a sample project, let me know. Please provide details on the version of your configuration software, specify which [product_name] you have (and provide its [article_no] or the starter kit code), as well as your software version.
Hi, that would be very helpful. The starter kit I have is [article_no]. The configuration software version is [product_name] V[version_no] ([version_no]) [snip].
Please check the attached file, which contains an example project using software version V[version_no] and configuration tool version V[version_no].

Thank you, but I am unable to get the [product_name] device to be detected in the programming software. When my project is opened, the scan for devices via USB interface starts and completes, but no devices are found. Scanning the Realtek PCIe GBE Family Controller interface finds one device on the network. I am able to connect to HMI_RT_1 via its MAC address. However, the hardware configuration was changed and not compiled or loaded yet, so diagnostics might be incorrect. There is a mismatch between the offline and online project target addresses for HMI_RT_1.
Did you try transferring the HMI program using the USB connection?
No, but I have it working now. I found the download-to-device button and the setup runs correctly. Thanks a lot for sharing your example program.

analysis.insight_summary: The main challenge was the lack of clear documentation for establishing communication between the [product_name] module and the HMI display, especially the setup steps in the relevant configuration and programming software. The user encountered issues with device detection during the scanning process. The problem was resolved after discovering the download-to-device feature, which helped complete the setup, revealing issues with usability and documentation at first but resulting in successful operation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for accessible, step-by-step instructions for configuring communication and data transfer between the [product_name] and HMI display, including device recognition and operational procedures in the associated programming and configuration software.
